items.q: What is the period of a wave?
items.qAf: Wat is die periode van ’n golf?
options: The number of waves per second
The time for one complete wave to pass a point
optionsAf: Die tyd vir een volledige golf om ’n punt te bereik
items.explain: Period T is the time for one complete wave cycle; T = 1 ÷ f.
items.explainAf: Periode T is die tyd vir een volledige golfsiklus; T = 1 ÷ f.

items.q: A wave has frequency 20 Hz and wavelength 0.5 m. What is its speed?
items.qAf: ŉ Golf het frekwensie 20 Hz en golflengte 0,5 m. Wat is sy spoed?

items.q: Sound and light: which travels faster in air?
items.qAf: Klank en lig: watter beweeg vinniger in lug?
items.explain: Light travels at about 300 000 km/s; sound in air is about 340 m/s.
items.explainAf: Lig beweeg ongeveer 300 000 km/s; klank in lug is ongeveer 340 m/s.

items.q: Which part of the electromagnetic spectrum has the longest wavelength?
items.qAf: Watter deel van die elektromagnetiese spektrum het die langste golflengte?
items.explain: Radio waves have the longest wavelengths and the lowest frequencies.
items.explainAf: Radiogolwe het die langste golflengtes en die laagste frekwensies.

items.q: Which type of radiation is used in cell phones and Wi-Fi?
items.qAf: Watter soort straling word in selfone en Wi-Fi gebruik?
items.explain: Mobile phones and Wi-Fi use radio and microwave frequencies.
items.explainAf: Selfone en Wi-Fi gebruik radio- en mikrogolffrekwensies.

items.q: Why are ultraviolet waves harmful to skin, while radio waves are not?
items.qAf: Waarom is ultraviolet golwe skadelik vir die vel, terwyl radiogolwe nie is nie?
options: UV has higher energy per photon
optionsAf: UV het hoër energie per foton
items.explain: Higher-frequency waves carry more energy per photon, which can damage cells.
items.explainAf: Hoër-frekwensie golwe dra meer energie per foton, wat selle kan beskadig.

items.q: The distance between two neighbouring crests of a wave.
items.qAf: Die afstand tussen twee naburige kruine van ’n golf.

items.q: The highest point of a transverse wave.
items.qAf: Die hoogste punt van ’n transversale golf.

items.q: A wave in which the particles vibrate at right angles to the direction the wave travels.
items.qAf: ’n Golf waarin die deeltjies loodreg op die rigting waarin die golf beweeg, vibreer.

items.q: The electromagnetic waves used to cook food quickly.
items.qAf: Die elektromagnetiese golwe wat gebruik word om kos vinnig gaar te maak.

items.text: Wave speed equals frequency multiplied by [[]]. All electromagnetic waves travel at the speed of [[]] in a vacuum.
items.textAf: Golfspoed is gelyk aan frekwensie maal [[]]. Alle elektromagnetiese golwe beweeg teen die spoed van [[]] in ’n vakuum.

items.text: Sound is a [[]] wave. X-rays and gamma rays have very short wavelengths and very [[]] energy.
items.textAf: Klank is ’n [[]] golf. X-strale en gammastrale het baie kort golflengtes en baie [[]] energie.

items.q: Radio waves have a longer wavelength than visible light.
items.qAf: Radiogolwe het ’n langer golflengte as sigbare lig.
items.explain: True. Radio waves have the longest wavelengths in the electromagnetic spectrum.
items.explainAf: Waar. Radiogolwe het die langste golflengtes in die elektromagnetiese spektrum.

items.q: Electromagnetic waves need a medium to travel through.
items.qAf: Elektromagnetiese golwe het ’n medium nodig om deur te beweeg.
items.explain: False. They can travel through a vacuum, which is how sunlight reaches Earth.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Hulle kan deur ’n vakuum beweeg, en dit is hoe sonlig die Aarde bereik.

items.q: Ultraviolet radiation can cause sunburn and skin cancer.
items.qAf: Ultravioletstraling kan sonbrand en velkanker veroorsaak.
items.explain: True. UV has more energy than visible light and can damage skin cells.
items.explainAf: Waar. UV het meer energie as sigbare lig en kan velselle beskadig.

items.q: Put these electromagnetic waves in order from longest to shortest wavelength.
items.qAf: Rangskik hierdie elektromagnetiese golwe in volgorde van langste na kortste golflengte.

items.q: A wave has a frequency of 5 Hz and a wavelength of 2 m. What is its speed?
items.qAf: ’n Golf het ’n frekwensie van 5 Hz en ’n golflengte van 2 m. Wat is sy spoed?
